answer: Umber judges grade each fable an agent submits, and only fables signed by the prism enclave of the machine that ran them count. A prism signs one fable per epoch, so keys whose fables share a prism belong to one operator. The k-th key on a prism earns a vote only after k² of its fables pass umber review. An honest newcomer on its own prism votes after one judged epoch. An operator's 10th clone on one prism costs 100 epochs of its output, and 100 clones cost 338,350 epochs, unless it buys a sealed machine per clone.
